Use-Case: UC-001 - View Requirements as a Document
Primary Actor: User
Goal: The user wants to view the requirements as a document in Doorstop.

Primary Success Scenario:
1. User logs into Doorstop.
2. User navigates to the "View Requirements" section.
3. Doorstop displays the requirements in a document format.
4. User can interact with the document to view details.

Alternative Scenario:
1. User logs into Doorstop.
2. User navigates to the "View Requirements" section.
3. Doorstop displays a message indicating that no requirements have been added yet.
4. User is prompted to add requirements.

Exception Scenario:
1. User logs into Doorstop.
2. User navigates to the "View Requirements" section.
3. Doorstop encounters a technical error and displays an error message.
4. User is notified of the error and advised to try again later.

attempts.artifact:
Use-Case 1: View Requirements as a Document
Primary Flow:
1. User logs into Doorstop.
2. User navigates to the "View Requirements" section.
3. User selects the option to view requirements as a document.
4. Doorstop generates a document containing all linked and formatted requirements.
5. User views the generated document.

Alternative Flow:
1. User logs into Doorstop.
2. User navigates to the "View Requirements" section.
3. User selects the option to view requirements as a document.
4. Doorstop fails to generate the document due to a technical issue.
5. User is notified of the failure and provided with an error message.

Exception Flow:
1. User logs into Doorstop.
2. User navigates to the "View Requirements" section.
3. User selects the option to view requirements as a document.
4. Doorstop prompts the user to confirm the export of personal data.
5. User denies the confirmation.
6. Doorstop does not proceed with the document generation.

test_cases.title: Primary Flow - View Requirements as a Document
steps: Navigate to the 'View Requirements' section.
Select the option to view requirements as a document.
Doorstop generates a document containing all linked and formatted requirements.
User views the generated document.
expected: The document contains all linked and formatted requirements.

test_cases.title: Alternative Flow - Document Generation Failure
steps: Navigate to the 'View Requirements' section.
Select the option to view requirements as a document.
Doorstop fails to generate the document due to a technical issue.
User is notified of the failure and provided with an error message.
expected: User is notified of a document generation failure and provided with an error message.

test_cases.title: Exception Flow - User Denies Data Export Confirmation
steps: Navigate to the 'View Requirements' section.
Select the option to view requirements as a document.
Doorstop prompts the user to confirm the export of personal data.
User denies the confirmation.
Doorstop does not proceed with the document generation.
expected: Doorstop does not proceed with the document generation due to user denial of data export confirmation.
